result.description:
About the Opportunity  

 A predominantly private billing practice in the Upper North Shore area is needing a vocationally registered female doctor to join their very busy team! Established for over 40 years this GP owned and operated family practice is only 150m away from the nearest train station with plenty of onsite parking and easy access via local buses. Due to increasing patient demand coverage is currently needed two days of the week with no after hours, evening or weekend work as the practice is open from Monday to Friday during standard business hours. You will be part of a very friendly clinical and administration team with a long-standing reputation for providing the highest quality care to patients from the local community and surrounding suburbs. Consultations are typically 15min in duration and rooms are fully equipped with heating and cooling facilities with pathology, pharmacies and imaging services conveniently located nearby. Range of services offered here include health assessments for heart disease and diabetes, cholesterol and blood pressure checks, care plans, general family medicine, innoculations, medication reviews, minor procedures, earwax removal and preventative medicine. If you're currently available for part-time work in the Killara area and would like to know more about this position, please  APPLY  now or contact us on the details below.
